content.text: {"regions": [{"id": "r2", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "the river in its literal sense; in the other case it means ‘ in a", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "hundred ways.’ The fig. is Arthântaranya'sa.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r3", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "Sl. 11. हुतभुक्—हुतं भुंक्ते ( aff. क्विप् ) fire. सूर्यः–सरति आकाशे", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "", "end": "space"}, {"n": 4, "text": "यद्वा सुवति कर्मणि लोकं प्रेरयति ( urges men to action ) इति. See", "end": "space"}, {"n": 5, "text": "Sid. Kau. on Pan. III, 1. 114. नाग—न गच्छतीति अगः न अगः नागः", "end": "space"}, {"n": 6, "text": "यद्वा नगे भवः । नागेषु इन्द्रः श्रेष्ठः यद्वा नागोयमिन्द्र इव upamita samas'a.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r4", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "निशित—p. p. of शो to sharpen; also शात. मन्त्रप्रयोग—मन्त्र is a", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "spell, a charm, प्रयोग is its employment for practical purposes.", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "विष—is m. and neu. औषध from ओषधि + अण् medicine. ओषः", "end": "space"}, {"n": 4, "text": "पाकः धीयते अस्यामिति ओषाधिः । विहित prescribed or laid down in", "end": "space"}, {"n": 5, "text": "the S'a'stras. मूर्खस्य &c.—i. e. for his folly.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r5", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "Sl. 12. साहित्य०—The best way is to take the comp. as", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "consisting of three things, viz साहित्य (सहितस्य भावः ष्यञ्) poetics,", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "composition, संगीत music and कला or arts. See com. जीवमानः—", "end": "space"}, {"n": 4, "text": "The verb जीव् is not Atm. and so the pre. p. ought to be जीवत्.", "end": "space"}, {"n": 5, "text": "But the form is defended by the following rule of Pán. ताच्छील्य-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 6, "text": "वयोवचनशक्तिषु चानश्. The term. आन ( चानश् and not शानच् )", "end": "space"}, {"n": 7, "text": "", "end": "space"}, {"n": 8, "text": "is applied to a root when it implies habit, age or power; भोगं भुञ्जानः", "end": "space"}, {"n": 9, "text": "( habit ), कवचं बिभ्राणः ( age. a young man ), शत्रून् निघ्नानः", "end": "space"}, {"n": 10, "text": "( power ). जीवमानः may, therefore, mean ‘ accustomed to live ’", "end": "space"}, {"n": 11, "text": "(ताच्छील्य); living. भागधेय–भाग एव भागधेयं Good luck. धेय is added", "end": "space"}, {"n": 12, "text": "to रूप, नाम and भाग, स्वार्थे i. e. without any alteration of sense.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r6", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "Sl. 13. ज्ञानम् may here refer to ‘ knowledge of the self, or", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "higher knowledge. गुणः=Such as courage, generosity of mind", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "&c. धर्मः—discharge of duty or religious merit. भुवि भारभूताः—", "end": "space"}, {"n": 4, "text": "a burden to the earth. मर्त्यलोके. In this world of mortals—", "end": "space"}, {"n": 5, "text": "should be construed with चरन्ति.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r7", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "मनुष्यरूपेण &c—The fig. here is Apahnuti. प्रकृतं यन्निषिध्यान्य-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 2, "text": "त्स्थाप्यते सात्वपह्नुतिः’ where the real thing ( the matter in hand,", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "the उपमेय ) is denied and some thing unreal ( the उपमान ) is", "end": "space"}, {"n": 4, "text": "affirmed in its place, that is Apahnuti. cf. विद्याविहीनः पशुः Sl. 20.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r8", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "Sl. 14. पर्वत fr. ( पर्वन् a joint, a part ). दुर्ग—the impassable", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "places. भ्रान्तम् p. p. used as a noun; for a similar use cf. गतं", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r1", "type": "page_number", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "( 8 )", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}], "units": [{"id": "u1", "type": "notes", "number": null, "label": null, "open_start": true, "open_end": true, "children": ["u2", "u3", "u4", "u5", "u6"]}, {"id": "u2", "type": "stanza_note", "number": null, "label": null, "open_start": true, "open_end": false, "children": ["r2"]}, {"id": "u3", "type": "stanza_note", "number": "11", "label": "Sl. 11", "open_start": false, "open_end": false, "children": ["r3", "r4"]}, {"id": "u4", "type": "stanza_note", "number": "12", "label": "Sl. 12", "open_start": false, "open_end": false, "children": ["r5"]}, {"id": "u5", "type": "stanza_note", "number": "13", "label": "Sl. 13", "open_start": false, "open_end": false, "children": ["r6", "r7"]}, {"id": "u6", "type": "stanza_note", "number": "14", "label": "Sl. 14", "open_start": false, "open_end": true, "children": ["r8"]}], "flows": [{"flow": "main", "units": ["u1"]}], "relations": []}
